<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/statements/names-and-require/">Names, namespaces and <code>require</code></a><span class="nv-section-count">10</span></h2>

<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/">Where state lives</a><span class="nv-section-count">7</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">A program holds state in five declared places. There is no <code>global</code>, no function static, and no host-populated variable.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#static-is-a-member-modifier"><code>static</code> marks a class member and names a class-relative type, and nothing else</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#no-function-static-and-no-global">A function holds no state of its own, and <code>global</code> does not exist</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#storage-that-outlives-a-call">A program holds state in five declared places, and the list is closed</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#an-isolate-has-its-own-statics">An isolate's class statics are its own, and a child cannot reach its parent's</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#no-host-populated-variables">No variable is ever populated by the host; every superglobal is a <code>Core</code> class member</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#globals-and-request-are-dropped-outright"><code>$GLOBALS</code> and <code>$_REQUEST</code> have no replacement of any kind</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/where-state-lives/#a-closure-binds-this-only-where-it-uses-it">A closure binds <code>$this</code> only when its body names it, so <code>static fn</code> has nothing left to assert</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li></ol>
</section>
<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/">By-reference and termination</a><span class="nv-section-count">6</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">A by-reference binding is written <code>inout</code> and said again at the call site; <code>&amp;</code> does not parse and <code>die</code> is refused.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#inout-is-the-by-reference-spelling">A by-reference binding is written <code>inout</code>, in the modifier slot before the type</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#inout-is-written-at-the-call">An argument that binds an <code>inout</code> parameter says so at the call</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#an-inout-argument-is-a-local">An <code>inout</code> argument is a local, and never an element or a property</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#there-is-no-out-mode">There is no write-only <code>out</code> mode</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#ampersand-is-not-a-by-reference-marker"><code>&amp;</code> in a by-reference position is refused at parse time</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/statements/by-reference-and-exit/#exit-is-the-only-termination-keyword"><code>exit</code> is the only process-termination keyword; <code>die</code> is refused</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li></ol>
</section>
